page.content:
6 August 1945 — first combat use of an atomic bomb.

How Hiroshima connects

  • Faction: Manhattan Project — The Manhattan Project built the bomb used on Hiroshima.
  • Faction: Imperial Japan — Hiroshima was the first atomic blow against Japan.
  • Event: Nagasaki — Nagasaki was bombed three days after Hiroshima.

What is Hiroshima?

The United States destroyed Hiroshima with a uranium bomb. Together with Nagasaki and the Soviet invasion of Manchuria, it preceded Japan's surrender.

Key threads lead to Manhattan Project, Imperial Japan and Nagasaki.
